from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFinding(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document's classification data."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    identified_cause: str = Field(description="The case cause category explicitly identified in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    findings: list[DocumentFinding]
